subject.title: fix(imessage): prevent missed messages after gateway crashes

question: Does the iMessage/durable-ingress owner accept the documented live-fence versus legacy-catchup tradeoff and consider a real crash/restart replay trace sufficient for this queue migration?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes persisted ingress, replay, and suppression behavior; source-level tests establish useful coverage but cannot independently settle the real transport and restart semantics.

options.title: Require transport proof
options.body: Request a redacted iMessage crash/restart transcript or recording that shows durable replay exactly once and verifies the configured catchup age window.

options.title: Accept the tested contract
options.body: Land based on the shared drain contract and focused unit coverage while explicitly accepting the remaining live-transport proof gap.

recommendation.title: Require transport proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted iMessage crash/restart transcript or recording that shows durable replay exactly once and verifies the configured catchup age window.
